reason: Metal stock and cargo mesh seem useful for making something to support the rover across loose sand.
expectation: I expect some kind of traction aid or crossing surface, though I don't know its exact form.

alternatives.reason: Sieving gravel might also help prepare the crossing, but the mesh and metal suggest a more direct traction aid.

effect: The panels spread wheel weight and hold gravel, so preparing gravel now appears to be the next step toward the crossing.
reaction: The raised edges give the panels a satisfying, practical purpose.
reason: Sieving at the gravel patch is the only numbered action and may prepare material for the traction panels.
expectation: I expect to obtain graded gravel suitable for the panels, though I don't know exactly what the sieve will produce.

effect: The sieve produced coarse gravel, which can now be combined with the traction panels.
reaction: The result was expected and makes the next step clear.
reason: The panels are designed to hold gravel, so filling them should prepare the crossing.
expectation: I expect gravel-filled traction panels that can support the rover over loose sand.

effect: The filled tracks complete the crossing preparation, and the explanation clarifies how the frames keep the supporting gravel from spreading sideways.
reaction: The finished tracks were satisfying to picture, though the result was expected.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making the traction panels was most worthwhile: their mesh bottoms and raised edges gave a clear practical explanation of how they could support a wheel on loose ground.

leastWorthwhile.text: Sieving the gravel was the least engaging passage; it was an expected preparation and the only numbered option at that point.

surprise.text: I had expected a traction aid, but the panels' role in holding gravel as well as spreading wheel weight added a useful detail.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary. The gravel and panels had a clear purpose, though the later steps offered only one numbered action each.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see what the sheltered exposure and second core reveal, although this chapter itself ended after a short, predictable preparation.
